notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.1
We've had some issues reported since the update, but hopefully these will be fixed soon! This patch contains mostly fixes with optimization in mind and a few bugs we've encountered.

Fixed "Double Trouble" achievement so not the host also can get it

Added v-sync option

Added frame rate limitation option

Added sound when you receive item as hacker

Thank you for your thoughts and reports on the game - continue doing so here! 📣

//the devs downstairs

notes.title: Cursed update and dev vacation
notes.notes:
Update time!
Hi Rats!

With summer taking place we've been taking it more casual then usual, but we got a new update for you - a cursed one! It comes with new gameplay for the hacker, read more about it below. Next week we at Studio Downstairs will be taking a short summer break for a week, but will be back shortly after with how the future will be 🫡🔦
Cursed what?
As the hacker in the later debts, you'll hear your heart pound a little harder then usual - something has entered the van... Find the source and throw it out trough the box.

With the new update, we've also updated the hacker tutorial (yayyy omg so exciting love tutorials)!
Added
Cursed items in the van

Cursed item tutorial to the hacker

Lightbulb note for when ghost is there
Fixed
Bug with the hacker box opening and closing

some box issues

issues with duplicates

If you find anything crucial, report it back to us trough the game report, community hub or discord - thank you everyone and we hope you have a nice summer 🤝



//the devs downstairs

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
It’s been just over a week since launch, and we’re thrilled to see so many of you enjoying the game. Now that things have settled, we’ve put together a major patch that tackles the issues you’ve reported and builds on what we’ve learned. We hope you like these improvements—and don’t forget to pay off your debt on time!

- Removed: Old voice line
- Fixed: Radio sound bug
- Fixed: Soft‑lock in tutorial
- Fixed: Game soft‑lock on loss
- Fixed: Death animation for the hacker
- Fixed: Van map syncing
- Fixed: Save files not being removed correctly
- Improved: Van item box functionality
- Improved: Lighting when the flashlight is turned off
- Added: Steam avatar and username display above players in the van lobby
- Added: Additional levels to the introduction debt
- Added: New voice lines and visual effects to remind you when it’s time to pay the debt
- Added: Option to skip the introduction debt
- Updated: Curtain‑van ghost event now triggers only on debt level 4 and above
- Updated: Introduction debt duration reduced to 1 day
- Updated: Death penalty changed to lose 25% of that night’s earnings
- Updated: Login screen font
- Updated: Frequency of computer shutdown events decreased

notes.notes:

🥂RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT🥂

Find or be Found will come out the 24th of June! 

We showcased our newest trailer with our release date during the Horror Award Showcase, but you can see our video here! The event has also a special sale on Steam where you can see all horror game participants 🤗

Steam Next Fest with a Demo update!
Next Fest is between 9th-16th of June and we will participate with a final update on our demo, the Ghost update! More on that later though...

We are so happy to have people in our lil community on Discord, your support means a lot - so thank you for sharing your thoughts and reporting both feedback and bugs on our current demo - Remember to leave a review on Steam if you enjoyed it 🐀💬


We hope you're looking forward to the full release!

//ghastly devs downstairs
